first_step_test: One slightly wobbly bold circle fixes the roll's final scale and gives the learner an immediate recognizable food silhouette.

source.notes: Reviewed six-panel black felt-tip and saturated marker raster sheet on paper; rejected lantern iterations remain private.

frames.visible_job: Draw one slightly wobbly round outer seaweed contour.
frames.instruction: With a black felt tip, make one generous circle that is slightly uneven like a hand-rolled sushi piece. Leave the center open for the rice and filling.

frames.visible_job: Nest one smaller round line inside the same outer circle.
frames.instruction: Follow the outer circle with a second smaller curve, leaving a fairly even dark seaweed band. Keep a broad white rice ring inside that band and an open center for the filling.

frames.visible_job: Add one salmon block, one cucumber wedge, and one carrot triangle in the established center.
frames.instruction: Inside the open middle, draw a rounded salmon block on the left. Tuck a curved cucumber wedge against its right edge and a small carrot triangle directly beneath the two, leaving white rice around all three.

frames.visible_job: Add one small dash each at left, top, and right within the white rice ring.
frames.instruction: Put one short rice-grain dash in the left rice band, one near the top, and one on the right. Keep them off the fillings and out of the dark seaweed wrap.

frames.visible_job: Add one curved white glint and one broken ground shadow.
frames.instruction: Add one short curved white gel-pen glint on the lower-right seaweed band. Place a small broken black marker shadow under the roll, centered beneath the outer circle, without moving the rice or fillings.

final_step.visible_job: Fill established shapes with saturated marker color and leave the rice open.
final_step.instruction: Fill the outer seaweed band deep navy-black, the salmon coral with two pale streaks, the cucumber green with a few light seed marks, and the carrot orange. Leave the rice ring mostly white with light cream marker dashes, and preserve the three black grain marks, white nori glint, and broken shadow.
adds: marker color on established wrap and fillings

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop shows only one bold slightly wobbly circular seaweed edge, centered with broad clear paper margins. A beginner can repeat that one gesture and still has open space for the inner rice line.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I inspected the full wide contact sheet and every saved square JPG adjacent pair. The outer wrap, nested rice boundary, left salmon, right cucumber, lower carrot, and three individual grain positions remain centered through the finish; the glint and shadow persist after Step 5. No temporary guides are used. The final marker fill stays inside earlier contours with visible felt-tip grain.

transitions.instruction_match: The instruction asks for one nested inner curve inside the established wrap; the new ring is visible, while the three fillings and rice marks remain absent.

transitions.observed_addition: The third crop keeps both nested circles in the same centered arrangement. A rounded salmon block sits left of center, a cucumber wedge touches it on the right, and a small carrot triangle meets them below.
transitions.instruction_match: The copy names the salmon, cucumber and carrot separately and locates their attachments; all three are inside the existing inner circle with rice space around them.

transitions.instruction_match: The written step asks for exactly three rice dashes at left, top and right, away from both the fillings and outer wrap; those are the new marks in the saved crop.

transitions.instruction_match: The updated instruction explicitly calls for a white gel-pen glint on the lower-right seaweed and a short ground shadow; both additions match the saved frame.

transitions.observed_addition: The saved finish retains the centered wrap, rice boundary, three touching fillings, left/top/right rice marks, lower-right white glint and broken shadow. Navy, cream, coral, green and orange marker strokes fill established regions; pale salmon streaks and cucumber seed marks are color details within their earlier outlines.
